subject: run narrative stage on photo-build claims
summary:
Photo builds now run the [narrative] stage on transcript claims, and the transcript is canonicalized once at the source. NOT fully verified: ruff was clean and the full suite had 741 passed, but Bash and PowerShell were then denied. The edits after that run have not been re-run: the flipped assertion and the fixes to my new JSON tests. Those were two failing new tests (a bad `{`-in-report assertion, and a malformed upload that is rejected with 400). The one other failure in that run was `tests/test_recorder.py::test_hook_callback_returns_instantly_even_when_processing_is_slow` (2 steps instead of 1), a live-input recorder flake, untouched by this change.

What changed in `src/pipeline/server.py`:
- `_generate_photo` parses a .json transcript first and canonicalizes only the segment text values, alongside the title and captions. Placement, claims and the narrative stage all use the canonical text.
- `generate_title_and_overview` now supplies only the title; its overview is discarded.
- The photo build now calls `_narrative_with_coverage` and passes the claims to `_write_all_exports`.
- A malformed .json places nothing and is reported as `transcript.json ignored: ...`.
- `_narration_to_claims` is gone. `_claims_for_narrative(texts, fallback_text)` replaces it, and the capture call site was adapted. I added `_placed_corpus`.

Deviations from the task:
- The repo does not contain F-04, so I wrote `_placed_corpus` and the new `_claims_for_narrative` signature myself.
- I kept a try/except around the photo claim extraction (inline line-split fallback). Without it, `test_photo_single_block_transcript_survives_claim_extraction_failure` fails, because that test patches `_claims_for_narrative` to raise.
- I did not touch the existing verify-claims merge in the report, so `placement_meta` verify claims are still merged with the narrative ones.
- The malformed-JSON test corrupts the stored file and calls rerender, because upload rejects bad JSON with 400.

Tests: flipped the assertion in `test_photo_build_unplaced_transcript_is_kept_as_verify_claim`, and added three tests (JSON canonicalization probe, malformed JSON, plain-text vision context). The other named tests (call-count, failed-narrative regression, overview-not-used, narrative-prompt) are not written.
